book.title: REVARESION Jon Gumbe Iesu Keriso Taibe Toyau Nunnewa

content: Mame onananeve ne meve yauna. Aneya 4 piyu ginawa 4 apa yokeeme, sira mu piyu egave taig 4 yumnateme. Taig 4 piyu egave, poeman egave, yoma da den tope.
Sira ne yauna. Aneya dawa me kum dauwaiviwa apa dauwag onivi. Me God wakeiviwa tobot batamiyawa aug onivi. Me noiwa wansin aneya 4 gumbo wane. Aneya 4 mu yusiwa munne piyu ge poemam watkukampe.
“Piyu, poeman, yoma da den watkukamiya. Namu nu God ankwatave nau emewa namuwo tobot batamiyawa barauta. Ivi mu watkukampe.”
Meve ne tobot batamiyawa basiyayawa anonawa, mu 144,000 Isuraeru usitainawa dam undag gumbe onamiya.
Iyayapan Obiren Di Wape Yobutatae Pupuyu Eniya

Mame onananeve ne meve yauna. Yawa. Iyayapan obiren di wakeya bira da oma den ane basiya mumpe. Mu at undag gumbo, dam undag gumbo, iyayapan undag gumbo ge gae undag gumbo onamiya. Mu kin seya meuma namive ge Sip Usiwa namive yokeeme. Mu wape muma puipuyuwa enamiya nanuwo bayan nanuwo yumnateme.

content.text: “Waita me God numawa gumbe, God me kin seya egave yan wakene.
Sira waita me Sip Usiwa gumbe.”

content: Aneya undag kin seyaeba, koukawa igiyawa ge vinenewa 4 wakeya gumbo birorot yokeya. Mu kin seyaeba namive kwanowa siyag konuwa yug God waiyag,

content.text: me God numawa gumbe evedni wakeigimpe. Amen!”

content: Koukawa igiyawa da ne didneg wane, “Iyayapan mame wape pupuyu eniyawa mu bira? Mu ampa onamiya?”
Ne me gumbe wana, “Ayapan neuma, ge anoana.” Meve me didnedne, “Iyayapan mame mu yaigiwa kokavit danave dauwag onamiya. Mu wape mumawa Sip Usiwa di meuma gumbe muiniya pupuyu aya.

content.text: mu God seya meuma namive wakeg oiyat ge aram temporu meuma danave nau meuma eme.
Sira kin seya meuma egave wakenewa me tent
Mu sira den di iyagon arampe,
Kuiyawa Sip Usiwa me kin seya meuma yapave wakeg sip amaraivi muma ape.
Me yoi yamarogu inaiinai yoiba mu wemun aipe.
Sira God mu yangowa undag it muin aorepe.”

footnotes.text: Me gugup gweyawa mina, sira Kembesi minawa gumbe umiya.
